cases.name: Original KPI regression
cases.dax: EVALUATE ROW("c0", [Order Count], "c1", [Sales Revenue], "c2", [Average Sales Order Value], "c3", [Unique Sales Customers], "c4", [Repeat Sales Customers], "c5", [Repeat Customer Rate], "c6", [Item Revenue], "c7", [Average Review Score])
